data.description: High Floor 2BR | Studio One | Marina View
data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is pleased to offer this bright high-floor 2-bedroom apartment in Studio One, Dubai Marina.

Set on the 31st floor, the apartment offers 1,104.05 sq ft, a clean unfurnished layout, floor-to-ceiling windows, balcony access, and open Marina/JBR skyline views.

The apartment features a modern open-plan kitchen with built-in oven and hob, light finishes, built-in wardrobes, and a practical layout suitable for tenants looking for a clean Marina home with strong views and easy access to the waterfront lifestyle.

Property details:
- Studio One, Dubai Marina
- 2 Bedrooms
- 1,104.05 sq ft
- High floor
- Marina / JBR skyline view
- Balcony
- Unfurnished
- Open-plan kitchen
- Built-in oven and hob
- Built-in wardrobes
- Designated parking: B1-139
- Vacant and available now
- Rent: AED 170,000
- 1 cheque preferred, serious offers may be reviewed

Studio One is a modern residential tower in Dubai Marina, positioned close to Marina waterfront, restaurants, retail, transport links, JBR, and key access routes.
